summary: Phase 136K, verification. Independently re-derived the AuthorityEpoch/AuthorityState field tables, state machines, and reference-family separation directly from CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.9/Sec.16/Sec.17/Sec.18/Sec.46 (not from 136J's own tests or report prose). Wrote 102 new independent adversarial tests (tests/test_cltr_cutover_136k_authority_core_independent_verification.py): 102 passed, 0 failed. Independently re-derived Sec.9's authority-role file list (13 forbidden + 2 permitted = 15 of 16 families) and confirmed NON-BLOCKING-136J-2's own reading: authority_epoch is genuinely omitted from Sec.9's explicit classification -- a real frozen-contract-text gap, not a 136J miscount; 136J's conservative schema-level choice is independently confirmed correct. Independently confirmed Sec.16 row 1's literal wording refers to a field/value pair (publication_state == cltr_authoritative) that does not exist on AuthorityState at all -- a pre-existing contract-text imprecision already reviewed at design level by 136D (PASS, no repair needed); 136J's actual implementation (authority_kind == cltr requires authoritative_generation) is confirmed a faithful interpretation. Reproduced and confirmed NON-BLOCKING-136J-1 unchanged and correctly disclosed. Repaired the manifest-status integrity gap 136I disclosed but did not fix (NON-BLOCKING-136I-2): load_and_verify_manifest (src/pcae/schema_runtime/manifest.py) now rejects any manifest entry whose status is not frozen as a ManifestIntegrityError, closing a fail-open path where a committed status=draft entry previously loaded and verified cleanly; independently reproduced against a Group 2 entry specifically before repairing; updated 136I's own pre-existing test in place. Disclosed (not repaired, no security impact) two further documentation-accuracy findings. Zero BLOCKING findings. Combined test_cltr_cutover_136h/i/j/k + schema-runtime suite: 706 passed, 0 failed (604 baseline + 102 new; the one repaired 136I test replaces its predecessor 1:1). Fast Green: 4391 passed, identical to the 136H/136I/136J baseline, zero regressions. Full unmarked suite freshly run: 20765 passed, 19 failed, 20784 total, 1191.48s -- all 19 failing node IDs byte-identical to the previously classified inherited-failure set (test_advisory_runtime_contract.py, test_advisory_runtime_architecture.py, test_phase_reports.py, test_rendering_134e5.py, test_finalization_transaction_134e10.py x5, test_cltr_migration_135p_verification.py x4, test_bootstrap_todo_consistency.py x2, test_cltr_135o_integration.py x4), zero new regressions. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. No CutoverRequest, ReadinessPackage, or any later-group record schema, typed model, semantic validator, or authority resolver/state/pointer was created or changed. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR REQUEST AND READINESS SCHEMA IMPLEMENTATION. Recommended next phase: 136L -- Request and Readiness Schema Implementation.
